contents.name: Codimension and correlator-based deformation criterion for group-like symmetry defects

source_review.read_extent: Retrieved the complete 77-page arXiv PDF and inspected the complete relevant introduction passage on PDF pp. 1–3, including the codimension-(q+1) definition, deformation invariance of correlation functions, and group fusion equations (1.1)–(1.2).
source_review.supports: The model-bound isotopy-invariance criterion and the codimension convention for topological symmetry operators.
source_review.limitations: The paper does not construct a general continuum QFT defect from arbitrary local field data and does not define a general interface between distinct models.

contents.name: Defect supports, labels, and isotopy classes in a functorial defect TQFT

source_review.read_extent: Retrieved the complete 42-page arXiv lecture-note PDF and read all of §2.1, PDF pp. 5–8, including the decorated bordism data, isotopy equivalence, and symmetric monoidal correlator assignment.
source_review.supports: A fully specified two-dimensional example of defect strata, labels, permitted incidences, and deformation equivalence in a model-defined correlator theory.
source_review.limitations: The detailed construction is oriented and two-dimensional; the notes say the general details above dimension three are not worked out. They do not establish a universal higher-dimensional or continuum construction.
